Hot-blooded American who keeps swearing this is his tournament.

How Paul Phoenix connects

  • Event: King of Iron Fist Tournament — Paul Phoenix has entered almost every King of Iron Fist Tournament.
  • Character: Marshall Law — Marshall Law is Paul Phoenix's long-running tournament friend.

What is Paul Phoenix?

Paul Phoenix is the blonde brawler who has entered almost every King of Iron Fist Tournament, forever one win short of the Mishima family ending the story without him.

Key threads lead to King of Iron Fist Tournament and Marshall Law.
